BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION L Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 22-F in the area bounded by:

South Holland Road; West 89" Street; the public alley next west of South
Holland Road

to those of a M2-1 Light Industry District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 200-22 W. 89" St./8840-76 S. Holland Road
